tha-ap316:1.1: samattaṃ. [314. Sattapaduminiya.] Nadī*kūle vasāmāhaṃ Nesādo nā*ma brāhmaṇo / satapattehi pupphehi sammajjitvāna assamaṃ. // //
tha-ap316:2.1: Suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ sambuddhaṃ Siddhatthaṃ lokanāyakaṃ / disvā 'va vane gacchantaṃ hāso me udapajjatha. // //
tha-ap316:3.1: Paccuggantvāna sa*mbuddhaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ* / assamam atināmetvā jalajaggehi okiriṃ. // //
tha-ap316:4.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhasaññāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap316:5.1: Ito te sattame kappe *caturo Pādapāvarā / sattaratanasa*mpannā cakkavattī mahabbalā. // //
tha-ap316:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Sattapaduminiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
